title: Pilates by Design

services.name: Private Sessions
services.desc: ​At Pilates By Design, we offer a range of options to ensure every client receives the attention and support they need, whether you're just beginning your Pilates journey or are an advanced practitioner looking to refine your form. Private sessions provide the ultimate 1:1 attention to help you focus on your unique needs and goals. Whether you're new to Pilates, recovering from an injury, or just want to perfect your form, a private session allows our instructors to give you tailored guidance and feedback. These sessions are great for anyone looking for a personalized, deep dive into the Pilates practice, ensuring that you’re using the right techniques to achieve your goals. Every level
